text_block_list.text:
One day, right after finishing up training 
with Eishin Flash...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, it seems it just wrapped up faster 
than anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If she were doing her usual number of 
sets, there's no way she could be done by 
this time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, she should have run the 
designated number of laps. If so, the only 
explanation is—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was training on my own, 
nothing like this ever happened.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, thank you. This is a result 
we could only achieve together."
choice_data_list: Let's keep giving it our all from here on!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Then we must review the schedule 
right away.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If it isn't any trouble, I would greatly 
appreciate your advice.

The fruits of coaching Eishin Flash seem 
to be clearly showing.
